'''2007 Texas State Championship Blake Huffman DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Blake Huffman]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Dark Deck I copied
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
